scope: Recorded Barry Knight’s official Independent ballot affiliation for the 2026 Cobar by-election. The 29 October unopposed declaration remains the election outcome.

sources.title: NSW Electoral Commission Cobar by-election ballot affiliation
sources.supports: The NSW Electoral Commission’s candidate list displays Barry Knight as Independent. Its separate declaration confirms he was elected unopposed on 29 October 2026. The historic declaration and polling dates retain their original meanings.
